title: dicranopteris nuda
intro: Dicranopteris nuda, commonly known as Black Fern or Male Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Osmundaceae. It is native to tropical Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Dicranopteris nuda include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions.
